DigitalOcean Droplets: pricing, free tier and alternatives (2026)

answer_raw:
The fastest option is a **GPU Droplet** [2], which provides specialized configurations for AI workloads [3].

The cheapest option to run a 7B model at all would be a **Basic Droplet** with at least 4 GB of RAM (priced at **$24/mo** as of 2026 [3]) or a **2 GiB Droplet** (priced at **$12/mo** as of 2026-09-21 [1]), though 2 GiB is likely insufficient for a 7B model without heavy quantization.

## Comparison of LLM Hosting Options

| Tier | Monthly Price | Use Case |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **GPU Droplet** | Pricing via vendor inquiry [2] | **Fastest** performance for LLM inference [3] |
| **4 GB RAM Droplet** | **$24/mo** as of 2026 [3] | Minimum viable for small quantized models |
| **2 GB RAM Droplet** | **$12/mo** as of 2026-09-21 [1] | Likely too low for a 7B model |

The **GPU Droplet** is the clear winner for speed because it is purpose-built for AI workloads [3]. For the cheapest possible path, you would look at the **4 GB RAM** tier at **$24/mo** as of 2026 [3] to ensure enough memory to load a quantized 7B model, whereas the **$12/mo** 2 GiB droplet is too small for reliable operation [1][3].
